reason: 该插件的主要面向功能是将 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面改造为可管理角色的人设聊天客户端：提供微信式左右栏对话界面、角色创建与头像生成，以及基于图片/视频生成功能的互动扩展；同时它依赖用户配置的 OpenAI 兼容接口并进行本地配置与文件存储，因此分类为界面导航面板类插件且具备外部服务集成风险。

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，可将界面替换为微信式双栏聊天体验，创建并管理 AI 角色，并通过配置的兼容接口完成聊天、照片分析和文生图/文生视频互动。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that provides a WeChat-style two-panel chat experience, lets you create and manage AI characters, and supports chat, image analysis, and image/video generation through configured compatible APIs.

capabilities: Injects a custom sidebar and conversation UI into the web client
Stores and reads local role/portrait data files for character profiles
Sends chat, vision, image, and video generation requests to user-configured API endpoints
Handles photo upload and multimodal processing through backend routes
Writes local DSH profile and plugin configuration files during installation

reasons.code: The plugin is documented as transforming the UI into a WeChat-style girlfriend-style chat interface with friend list, conversation panel, and companion-role setup.
README describes role data and avatar files being stored under `<DSH 主目录>/storages/girlfriend/` and API keys/config in browser localStorage, while `/girlfriend/*` routes proxy model requests.
Package metadata identifies a web UI plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`/slots) and a postinstall script that generates profile/config files under DSH directories.
